title: Genetic algorithm neural network on CT radiomics predicts MSI in colorectal cancer
summary: In 837 colorectal cancer patients from two hospitals, a genetic algorithm-enhanced artificial neural network on ten CT radiomics features predicted MSI status with AUC 0.788 internally and 0.775 externally, above a clinical model (0.768 and 0.623). The signature also stratified stage II prognosis (HR 0.402, p=0.029).
ai_technology: Genetic algorithm-enhanced artificial neural network on CT radiomics features
organization: Guangdong Academy of Medical Sciences; Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital; Southern Medical University

evidence.tested: Internal and external validation cohorts from two hospitals.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; modest AUC; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Neural network model built the radiomics signature for MSI prediction.
